newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 30.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
* Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Yasir Arafat have agreed to go to Washington this week to find a way to avoid a confrontation that could dash their peace pact.
* U.S. President Bill Clinton's government is expanding a programme to trade surplus public areage in an effort to take environmentally sensitive sites out of private hands.
* Clinton's invitation to Netanyahu and Arafat to meet in Washington carries political and diplomatic risks.
* U.S. Olympic athletes have returned to their homes to ask themselves whether they should compete in the next Olympic games or quit and pursue other personal and professional interests.
* Republicans succeeded in making the 104th Congress the most parsimonious ever by making deep cuts in programs with which they disagreed.
